Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: finished transparent 2D sprite for a Japanese convenience-store management game, shelf_general FULL rotation r0, candidate A.
Input image 1: canonical EMPTY r0 sprite, use as STRICT projection/geometry guide, not as a 3D rendering style reference.
Create ONE complete integrated shelf AND fully stocked products sprite. Keep exactly the reference camera, long-axis direction, overall length and outer silhouette. Preserve the four front shelf lip lines, vertical posts, top outline and bottom outline at the reference positions. The long edges rise to the right at dy/dx=-0.5; short edges descend to the right at dy/dx=+0.5. Orthographic, no vanishing points. Entire sprite same relative framing as reference; requested canvas 442x449 or a uniform integer enlargement only.
Style: polished hand-painted 2D game illustration with crisp restrained dark outlines, broad flat color areas, just two subtle shade values, no realistic rendering or dimensional box shading. Shallow DOUBLE-SIDED gondola with slim central spine implied; do not widen the depth. Keep the cap but paint it softly in flat cool gray.
Fill ALL FOUR existing shelf tiers densely with large readable adjacent snack pouches, rounded instant-noodle cups and a few soft bread packages; warm red/orange/yellow merchandise, some green/cream accents. Product fronts occupy most of each open shelf band and touch/overlap their neighbors in cohesive continuous stocked rows. Package bases sit directly on and are occluded by the thin continuous shelf front lip. Small crimped pouch tops, curved cups, bread shapes establish actual groceries, NOT rectangular cards. Follow same -0.5 row alignment. Show only very narrow slivers of bare shelf surfaces; products approximately 75-85% of usable shelf opening. Small flat contact accents bind merchandise to shelf. No detached floating icons, individually outlined white sticker borders, equal spaced cards, cuboid cartons, big visible box top/side planes, deep shelves, endcap display additions, people, logos, legible text, scenery, floor, cast shadow, background, checkerboard, dimension guides. Genuine alpha background including open spaces, single finished unified sprite.

Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset: shelf_general FULL/r0 candidate A revision 2, a FINISHED TRANSPARENT FLAT 2D GAME SPRITE.
REFERENCE 1 is the canonical EMPTY shelf. This is the absolute projection, length, silhouette and shelf-row guide. Reference 2 is a rejected stocked draft: borrow ONLY its touching groceries density/contact, NOT its texture, lettering, frame proportions or dimensional rendering.
Draw one integrated flat 2D illustrated shallow double-sided convenience gondola fully stocked on all four existing levels. Exactly reproduce reference 1 frame geometry and framing: cap corner coordinates on 442x449 canvas: (40,132),(285,8),(402,67),(157,191); base bottom front point (157,425), left (40,365), right (402,301). Long rails parallel vector (+245,-124). All vertical posts vertical. Only uniform enlargement allowed; no perspective/rotation/stretching. FOUR levels of merchandise under cap.
Flat painted game art, crisp 1-2px contour at native resolution, small palette, two flat tones per material. No gradients, gloss, texture, photorealistic illustration, 3D/rendered appearance or product photography. Groceries must read at 100px sprite height.
Front-load large simple crimped soft snack pouches, squat round noodle cups and rounded transparent-wrap bread in tightly touching grouped rows, physically resting behind shelf lips. Mostly coral/red/gold/cream, a few green accents. Soft silhouette and small flat food pictograms only; NO writing, letters, characters, numbers, logos or text-like marks. Product masses occupy 80% of shelf openings; suppress empty flat shelf surfaces. No separate white card outlines or isolated sticker icons. No cuboid boxes or prominent product side/top faces. A few natural overlaps, narrow contact shadows, package bases occluded by continuous rails. Keep cap and full length to canonical. Narrow central spine and shallow both-side stock implied without adding a new endcap or changing outer silhouette.
Single whole shelf+stock finished sprite, transparent alpha outside and through genuine holes. NO ground shadow, background, floor, checker pattern, annotation, diagram or multiple views.

Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset: shelf_general FULL/r0 candidate B. ONE completed unified transparent 2D shelf-with-stock game sprite.
Input image: canonical empty shelf, STRICT projection guide. Preserve its exact isometric r0 direction, length, aspect and contour, shelf levels and post positions. On a 442x449 canvas the top cap corners are (40,132),(285,8),(402,67),(157,191), bottom front (157,425), bottom left (40,365), bottom right (402,301). Long shelf rails run (+245,-124), slope -0.5061, short edges slope +0.5; verticals stay vertical. Uniform enlargement only; no altered proportions, view angle, foreshortening or camera perspective.
Art direction: true FLAT HAND-DRAWN 2D GAME ART. Solid color fills, simple restrained contour, at most two flat shade colors each. NOT a 3D render. NO glossy materials, smooth gradient shading, photographic packaging or dimensional cuboid products. Keep canonical cool gray shallow gondola frame/cap, small muted teal shelf edge accents, shallow double-sided aisle fixture with thin central spine suggested. No extra endcap.
Stock FOUR levels densely, all groceries fully integrated with continuous shelf lips, touching neighbors, narrow overlap and grounded bases occluded behind the shelf rail. B differs from warm snack-heavy A by using larger rounded pastel cream/green/terracotta bread bags and soft grocery pouches grouped in pairs, plus squat circular noodle bowls with simple oval lids. Mostly cream, sage green, muted yellow and small coral. Merchandise should fill 80-90% of shelf openings, almost no broad empty shelf surfaces, a strong coherent stocked mass at small game scale. In each level use about 6-8 broad facing shapes along the long side, no tiny evenly spaced stickers. Products have curved bags, crimped seams and simple flat food symbols. No boxes with visible 3D side faces, no individual white card borders, no floating separated cards, no checkerboard, no labels/text/glyphs/numbers/logos.
Keep long-axis length and all four shelf tiers exactly registered to guide. Genuine transparent alpha background and small genuine open gaps; no floor or cast shadow. Whole sprite fits uncropped with same margins as canonical. Requested 442x449 or uniform integer enlargement.
